sop_modules.name: Fine Finish Setup
sop_modules.description: Protection and staging for fine finish work

tasks.name: Clean Surfaces and Floors
tasks.description: Remove dust, debris from work area

tasks.name: Set Floor/Surface Protection
tasks.description: Lay drop cloths, mask adjacent surfaces

sop_modules.name: Fine Finish Initial Prep
sop_modules.description: Heavy prep before first finish coat per Fine Finish Doctrine

tasks.name: Fill Fastener Holes
tasks.description: Fill nail holes, screw holes, staple marks

tasks.name: Full Surface Sand
tasks.description: Sand entire surface for adhesion and smoothness

tasks.name: Clean Sanding Dust
tasks.description: Remove all sanding dust before coating

sop_modules.name: Fine Finish Interstage
sop_modules.description: Between-coat maintenance per Fine Finish Doctrine
sop_modules.run_rule: Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat

tasks.name: Clean Work Area
tasks.description: Clean floors, flat surfaces, remove dust and debris

tasks.name: Inspect Coat
tasks.description: Visual inspection, mark defects for repair

tasks.name: Light Sand
tasks.description: Scuff sand surface per tier requirements

tasks.name: Patch/Repair Defects
tasks.description: Fill holes, repair damage found during inspection

tasks.name: Spot Coat Patches
tasks.description: Touch prime or finish patched areas

tasks.name: Final Inspection
tasks.description: Final quality check per tier scrutiny standard

tasks.name: Remove Protection
tasks.description: Remove masking, drop cloths, clean up

_template_notes.usage: Copy this template when creating Fine Finish spec SOP modules
customization: Add surface-specific prep tasks to MOD_FF_INITIAL_PREP
Add primer module (MOD_FF_PRIME) if primer is required
Add finish coat modules (MOD_FF_FINISH_COAT) as needed
Adjust task descriptions for specific surface type
